description: Bridge status: extension connection, server mode (primary/relay), host, port, server and extension versions, js_evaluation (false under --no-js), write_root and read_root, caps_active and caps_available (a tool missing from the list lives in an inactive cap), session_tab_id (the implicit tab), owned_tabs (created by this session), uptime_sec. enable switches caps on for this session, no restart. Optional caps: audits (cookie_audit); visual (inject_css, measure_spacing, emulate_media, viewport_resize); perf (animations, frames, perf_trace, screencast, lighthouse, heap_snapshot); network (http_auth, set_geolocation, track_events); storage (get_storage, set_storage, session_fixture); dom (modify_dom, watch_dom, drag_and_drop); files (save_page, manage_downloads, session_record).

enable.description: Caps to switch on now, all in one call; "all" = every cap

name: get_status
